title: YEEZY 450 INFANT
description: The adidas Yeezy 450 Infant ‘Cloud White’ presents the debut colorway of a futuristic Yeezy model scaled down for little feet. Decorative no-tie stretch laces are integrated into the flexible knit upper, featuring an elastic cuff for a sock-like fit. A molded EVA midsole combines with an Ortholite sockliner to deliver lightweight cushioning, while its unique structure forms a supportive cage. Underfoot, the rubber outsole features a wavy traction pattern for added grip.

title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘MX Sand Grey’ updates the flexible clog-like silhouette with a neutral blend of colors. The one-piece foam upper is finished in a refined tan hue with swirling hits of grey and dark beige throughout the side panels, heel, and outsole, featuring a wavy traction pattern for enhanced grip. A series of ventilation ports in varying sizes and shapes offer breathable comfort, while the sculpted heel is designed to cradle the back of the foot.
